metadata.title: Adivasi Youth will play a major role in MP Elections - Dr Hiralal Alawa | डॉ हीरालाल अलावा इंटरव्यू
metadata.description: Dr Hiralal Alawa is a very well known tribal leader in the state of Madhya Pradesh. At present he is also member of the legislative assembly of the state. In an exclusive interview with Main Bhi Bharat, he says that now Adivasis are not puppet any more in state politics. They are claiming their rightful place in the power structure and politics.
